ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 0.4:0.6 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central low-intensity black blob extending from the peduncle to the trailing edge, flanked by two high-intensity white fields on the distal lobes. The white fields are heavily intersected by low-intensity linear streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged trailing edge topography with frequent pixel-level peaks and valleys (amplitude 5-15 pixels) across the entire boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges exhibit a sharp convex sweep towards the tips; trailing edges follow a sigmoidal curve, concave near the tips and convex as they approach the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small, roughly circular dark pixel clusters (3-8 pixels in diameter) detected on the white fields of both lobes, consistent with barnacle scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast dark linear and curvilinear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white areas, including a prominent vertical-oblique line on the left lobe and an arc on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring mapping across the white ventral surfaces of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinctive dark arched pigment feature on the distal white region of the right lobe and a prominent vertical line on the left lobe.
